_readme: STAGE-10 TASK 3 — the structured bug database. One record per observed defect.
Lives in the repository, NOT only in the factory DB: it must survive a DB wipe.
classification is one of: factory_defect | model_compliance | environment | unknown.
'unknown' is legitimate and expected. NEVER force a classification you cannot
evidence — a wrong label sends the next investigation in the wrong direction.
status is one of: open | explained | fixed.
Watch items from the K13 signature (STAGE-10-AGENT-BRIEF.md 'Watch items') are
'vii' (planner-skill domain neutrality) — evidence lands where the decision already is.
evidence_pointer must name the exact journal record, snapshot path, or DB row —
not prose about where to look.

schema.evidence_pointer: journal line / snapshot path / DB query — exact

records.expected: the first discovery-proposal author worker finishes its turn and calls worker_done (its workspace file edits were live seconds before death — the operator watched the model filling the proposal on the dashboard)
records.happened: worker exited at exactly 20m00s runtime with exit_code 1, no worker_done; stdout (shim JSONL) frozen since 06:22:48Z (16 min before death) while workspace file writes continued; the factory recovered the assignment and spawned a replacement in ~300ms (journal: worker.exit -> assignment.claimed -> execution.reserved -> worker.spawn all at 06:38:54)
records.evidence_pointer: factory-run-journal.jsonl lines 4-7 @ 06:38:54.155-.456Z; worker JSONL .factory-sandboxes/stage10-logs/board-1-10940-1787120334001/task-1-worker-ef156416-fcdb-4514-aad4-db51635ff809.jsonl (mtime frozen 06:22:48Z, 19371 bytes); duration_ms=1200112 in the worker.exit record

records.expected: the engine writes its operator log, heartbeat marker and phase marker (quickstart §5, engine-file-logger), enabling [progress-invariant] observation and stale-engine detection
records.happened: on the `factory.mjs start` path SAGA_ENGINE_LOG is never set: no saga-engine-*.log exists for launch-94507c42 (only stale logs from earlier sessions, since deleted); the engine's stdout is buffered inside the factory.mjs pipe and unreadable until that process exits; engine heartbeat/phase markers do not exist for this run
records.evidence_pointer: factory_launch_requests row launch-94507c42-7fa5-46f6-a766-5d6145d3a30d: engine_log_path IS NULL; absence of any saga-engine-*.log newer than run start in %TEMP%

records.expected: the worker-card log tail loads in the observer front
records.happened: the UI showed 'err unknown endpoint: /api/worker/tail' next to the worker card; /api/worker/tail is a tracker-view (4321) endpoint and is NOT served by core-view (4325, only /api/core/*); the request reached core-view's responder. The dashboard's own logTail terminal (workspace-file based) worked and showed live model thoughts
records.evidence_pointer: operator screenshot text 2026-08-19 09:36; core-view/server.mjs endpoint set (/api/core/heartbeat|projects|snapshot|events|cell only); tracker-view/shared.mjs:172 owns /api/worker/tail

records.expected: after the FINAL gate decision 'accepted' for the acceptance-contract cell, a CellFinalAcceptance is recorded and the solution-formalization module routes to Development
records.happened: the engine re-opened the author card (assignment.claimed task 8 at 08:13:12, right after obligation.settled) with NO recovery feedback present (worker's recovery-feedback.json read fails 'File not found'); factory_cell_final_acceptances has 0 rows for this workplace (4 total, all earlier cells); solution-formalization stays 'paused'; the worker performs a fresh author pass over already-accepted material — CONVEYOR §15 'cycle vs spinning' third class: a re-dispatch with NO reason at all
records.evidence_pointer: journal lines @08:13:12 (obligation.settled -> assignment.claimed task8 -> worker.spawn); gate decisions for the workplace: author accepted -> final repair_required -> author accepted -> final ACCEPTED; DB: factory_cell_final_acceptances count 0 for workplace; worker log D:\Development\saga-mcp\.factory-sandboxes\stage10-logs\board-1-10940-1787127192020\task-8-worker-f6c8b42e-ec58-4bbb-ac33-958165a0c697.jsonl (recovery-feedback.json File not found)

records.expected: after the AC-contract final gate accepts, the engine captures the replay capsule and the lifecycle routes to Development
records.happened: engine exited code=1; durable launch error: REPLAY_CAPTURE_TRACE_NOT_FOUND: expected 12, resolved 6; lifecycle run 1 is TERMINAL failed at solution-formalization (finalStage solution-formalization, cycles 2, scopeCompleted false). The FINAL GATE had ACCEPTED the same material the replay capture then rejected — two authorities with different predicates on the same boundary. This terminates the B-004 re-dispatch loop as a run death
